traditions.name: Ascended Master Teachings (I AM Activity / Summit Lighthouse)
traditions.earliest_attestation: 1932 CE (I AM Activity of Guy and Edna Ballard)
traditions.scholarly_note: A reworking of Theosophy's Masters of the Ancient Wisdom into a devotional, decree-based religion. Main branches: the I AM Activity (Saint Germain Foundation, 1930s), the Bridge to Freedom (1951), The Summit Lighthouse (Mark L. Prophet, 1958) and the Church Universal and Triumphant (Elizabeth Clare Prophet, 1975). Hanegraaff, New Age Religion and Western Culture (1996) treats channeled Master teachings as a core strand of New Age religion.

traditions.name: New Age Channeled Revelation
traditions.earliest_attestation: 1963 CE (Jane Roberts' Seth sessions); antecedents in 19th-c. Spiritualism
traditions.scholarly_note: Channeling, in which a medium gives voice to a non-physical teacher, is one of the defining practices of the New Age movement; Hanegraaff, New Age Religion and Western Culture (1996) analyses Seth, A Course in Miracles, Ramtha and similar corpora as primary New Age scriptures.

traditions.name: New Age holistic spirituality
traditions.earliest_attestation: 1970s CE (roots in Theosophy, New Thought, Spiritualism and the 1960s counterculture)
traditions.geographic_origin: USA and UK (Esalen, Findhorn, global networks)
traditions.scholarly_note: A loose, network-based religiosity rather than a single church. Hanegraaff, New Age Religion and Western Culture (1996) describes it as a form of secularised Western esotericism that blends Theosophical cosmology, New Thought psychology of mind, and holistic healing.

traditions.name: Goddess Spirituality (feminist Goddess movement)
traditions.scholarly_note: Overlaps with feminist Wicca (Reclaiming) and New Age Divine Feminine teachings. Its historical claim of a universal prehistoric Goddess religion is disputed by most archaeologists and historians.

traditions.name: New Thought (Unity, Religious Science, Divine Science)
traditions.earliest_attestation: 1880s CE (Emma Curtis Hopkins' students; Unity founded 1889)
traditions.geographic_origin: USA (Boston, Chicago, Kansas City, Los Angeles)
traditions.scholarly_note: Grows from the mental-healing work of Phineas P. Quimby (d. 1866) and runs parallel to Christian Science. A major source of New Age ideas about mind creating reality (Hanegraaff, New Age Religion and Western Culture (1996)).

traditions.name: Reiki (Usui Reiki Ryōhō and its lineages)
traditions.geographic_origin: Tokyo, Japan; spread to the West via Hawaii from the 1930s
traditions.scholarly_note: A hands-on healing practice transmitted by initiation (attunement) through teacher lineages that trace back to Mikao Usui. Most practitioners do not treat it as a religion; lineage veneration of Usui is the devotional element.

traditions.name: Core Shamanism / Neo-shamanism
traditions.earliest_attestation: 1980 CE (Michael Harner, The Way of the Shaman)
traditions.geographic_origin: USA (Foundation for Shamanic Studies), then global
traditions.scholarly_note: A Western synthesis that abstracts common elements from many Indigenous shamanic cultures. Indigenous critics and scholars question its universalising method and its detachment from the source communities.

traditions.name: Neo-Andean spirituality (mística andina)
traditions.geographic_origin: Cusco region of Peru; global New Age networks
traditions.scholarly_note: A revival and globalisation of Andean ritual (despacho offerings, Pachamama and Apu veneration) in which Q'ero and other Quechua ritual specialists teach foreign seekers. Continuous with village practice but reframed in New Age terms.

traditions.name: Mestizo Amazonian vegetalismo (ayahuasca curanderismo)
traditions.earliest_attestation: 19th–20th c. CE (rubber-boom Amazon), drawing on older Indigenous practice
traditions.geographic_origin: Peruvian Amazon (Iquitos, Pucallpa) and neighbouring regions
traditions.scholarly_note: The healing tradition of mestizo vegetalistas, who learn from 'plant teachers' (plantas maestras) and sing icaros. Since the 1990s it has fed a global ayahuasca-retreat scene.

traditions.name: Santo Daime
traditions.earliest_attestation: 1930 CE (first public works of Raimundo Irineu Serra, Rio Branco)
traditions.scholarly_note: A Brazilian ayahuasca religion that unites Catholic devotion, Afro-Brazilian and Spiritist elements and Amazonian vegetalismo. Its branches include Alto Santo and CEFLURIS (founded by Padrinho Sebastião Mota de Melo).

traditions.name: União do Vegetal (Centro Espírita Beneficente União do Vegetal)
traditions.scholarly_note: A Brazilian Christian-Spiritist religion whose sacrament is the hoasca tea. The US Supreme Court upheld its sacramental use in Gonzales v. O Centro Espírita (2006).

traditions.name: Bwiti
traditions.earliest_attestation: 19th c. CE (Mitsogo and Apindji forms); Fang syncretic branches from the early 20th c.
traditions.geographic_origin: Gabon, with branches in Equatorial Guinea and Cameroon
traditions.scholarly_note: An initiatory religion centred on the iboga root. Fang Bwiti (Bwiti Fang) blends ancestor cult with Christian figures.

traditions.name: Mazatec religion (Sierra Mazateca)
traditions.earliest_attestation: Pre-Columbian roots; sacred mushrooms (teonanácatl) recorded in 16th-c. Mesoamerican sources
traditions.scholarly_note: Mazatec Catholicism with a living tradition of healing veladas (night vigils) led by wise ones (chjota chjine). The 1950s visits of outsiders to María Sabina made the tradition famous and brought great disruption to Huautla.

traditions.name: Northern Peruvian curanderismo (mesa tradition)
traditions.earliest_attestation: Colonial period to present; the cactus appears in Chavín art (c. 1000–200 BCE)
traditions.geographic_origin: Northern coast and highlands of Peru
traditions.scholarly_note: Night healing ceremonies around a mesa (altar) of power objects, in which the San Pedro cactus is the central plant. Catholic saints and pre-Hispanic powers are invoked together.

traditions.name: Kriya Yoga lineage (Self-Realization Fellowship / Yogoda Satsanga)
traditions.earliest_attestation: 1861 CE (Lahiri Mahasaya's initiation, per lineage account); SRF founded 1920
traditions.scholarly_note: Paramahansa Yogananda's lineage was one of the main routes by which Hindu guru devotion reached Western alternative spirituality.

primary_sources: The Secret Doctrine (H. P. Blavatsky, 1888), Proem
The Key to Theosophy (H. P. Blavatsky, 1889)
deities.etymology: Sanskrit para-brahman, 'the supreme Brahman', borrowed from Vedānta
deities.summary: The first fundamental proposition of the Secret Doctrine: an omnipresent, eternal, boundless and immutable Principle about which all speculation is impossible, since it transcends human thought. It is not a Being but Be-ness, the rootless root of all that was, is, or ever shall be. From it, in periodic outbreathings, come the universes.

alternate_names: the Messenger of the Cosmic Will
primary_sources: The Secret Doctrine (H. P. Blavatsky, 1888), vol. 1, Stanzas of Dzyan V–VII
deities.summary: Fohat is the dynamic energy of Cosmic Ideation, the bridge by which the ideas in the Divine Mind are impressed on cosmic substance. 'Thought is the rider, Fohat the steed.' He digs holes in space, traces spiral lines, and sets the atoms whirling into worlds.

primary_sources: The Secret Doctrine (H. P. Blavatsky, 1888), vol. 1
deities.etymology: Blavatsky's coinage from Sanskrit dhyāna ('meditation') and Tibetan chos-rje ('lord of dharma')
deities.summary: The Dhyan Chohans are the hosts of divine intelligences who supervise the cosmos: the 'Builders' who shape worlds after the plan held in the Universal Mind. Blavatsky equates them with the archangels of the Church and the Elohim of the Bible, ranged in seven great hierarchies.

primary_sources: The Secret Doctrine (H. P. Blavatsky, 1888), vol. 1, Stanzas IV–V
deities.summary: The Lipika are the celestial Recorders who write the karmic record of every being on the invisible tablets of the Astral Light, the great picture-gallery of eternity. They 'trace the triangle' that separates spirit from matter, and they apportion karma.

primary_sources: The Secret Doctrine (H. P. Blavatsky, 1888), vol. 2 (Anthropogenesis)
Man: Whence, How and Whither (Annie Besant and C. W. Leadbeater, 1913)
Initiation, Human and Solar (Alice A. Bailey, 1922)
deities.summary: In the middle of the Lemurian epoch, about eighteen million years ago, the Lords of the Flame came from Venus, led by Sanat Kumara. They lit the spark of mind in animal-man, making him a thinking and self-conscious being, and founded Shamballa, the hidden centre of the planet's spiritual government.

alternate_names: the Lord of Shamballa (in his reflection)
the One in Whom we live and move and have our being
primary_sources: Initiation, Human and Solar (Alice A. Bailey, 1922)
A Treatise on Cosmic Fire (Alice A. Bailey, 1925)
deities.summary: The Planetary Logos is the great Life whose body is the Earth with all its kingdoms. Every human, animal and mineral is a cell in his body. He expresses himself on the physical plane through Sanat Kumara, the Lord of the World, at Shamballa, and is himself one of the seven Heavenly Men within the Solar Logos.

primary_sources: The Secret Doctrine (H. P. Blavatsky, 1888)
A Treatise on Cosmic Fire (Alice A. Bailey, 1925)
deities.summary: The Solar Logos is the God of our solar system, whose physical body is the sun and planets. He works through three aspects (Will, Love-Wisdom and Active Intelligence, the Father, Son and Holy Spirit) and through the Seven Planetary Logoi, as seven centres in his body.

deities.primary_name: The One About Whom Naught May Be Said
alternate_names: He About Whom Naught May Be Said
primary_sources: A Treatise on Cosmic Fire (Alice A. Bailey, 1925)
deities.summary: Beyond the Solar Logos stands a still greater cosmic Life, of which our whole solar system is only a part. Alice Bailey's Tibetan teacher calls him the One About Whom Naught May Be Said, to show the limits of human knowledge before the higher reaches of the cosmic hierarchy.

alternate_names: the Masters of the Ancient Wisdom
primary_sources: Isis Unveiled (H. P. Blavatsky, 1877)
The Mahatma Letters to A. P. Sinnett (letters 1880–1884, published 1923)
The Masters and the Path (C. W. Leadbeater, 1925)
Initiation, Human and Solar (Alice A. Bailey, 1922)
deities.summary: The Masters of the Ancient Wisdom are perfected humans who have finished their human evolution and stay near the Earth to guide it. Organised under Sanat Kumara into three great departments, led by the Manu, the Bodhisattva (World Teacher) and the Mahachohan, they guard the Ancient Wisdom and train disciples.

alternate_names: the Master of the Second Ray
primary_sources: The Mahatma Letters to A. P. Sinnett (letters 1880–1884, published 1923)
The Occult World (A. P. Sinnett, 1881)
The Masters and the Path (C. W. Leadbeater, 1925)
deities.summary: Koot Hoomi is a Kashmiri-born adept and one of the two Mahatmas who sponsored the Theosophical Society. His letters taught A. P. Sinnett the cosmology of the Ancient Wisdom. Leadbeater names him as Pythagoras in a former life; for Bailey he is Master of the Second Ray of Love-Wisdom and will one day succeed Maitreya as World Teacher.

alternate_names: the Master of the First Ray
primary_sources: The Mahatma Letters to A. P. Sinnett (letters 1880–1884, published 1923)
Isis Unveiled (H. P. Blavatsky, 1877)
The Masters and the Path (C. W. Leadbeater, 1925)
deities.summary: Morya is the Rajput adept whom Blavatsky called her own Master, first met, she said, in London in 1851. With Koot Hoomi he inspired the Theosophical Society. In the Hierarchy he is Master of the First Ray of Will and Power, working under the Manu.

primary_sources: A Treatise on White Magic (Alice A. Bailey, 1934)
Esoteric Psychology (Alice A. Bailey, 1936)
The Externalisation of the Hierarchy (Alice A. Bailey, 1957)
The Secret Doctrine (H. P. Blavatsky, 1888)
deities.summary: Djwal Khul, 'the Tibetan', is a Master of the Second Ray and a disciple of Koot Hoomi. From 1919 to 1949 he dictated telepathically to Alice A. Bailey some twenty-four volumes on the Seven Rays, esoteric astrology and healing, and the coming reappearance of the Christ.

primary_sources: The Masters and the Path (C. W. Leadbeater, 1925)
Initiation, Human and Solar (Alice A. Bailey, 1922)
deities.summary: Master Rakoczi, the last survivor of the royal house of Rákóczi, is the Master who appeared in eighteenth-century Europe as the Comte de Saint-Germain. He is Master of the Seventh Ray of Ceremonial Order and Magic and works on the coming civilisation of the Aquarian age.

alternate_names: Apollonius of Tyana (later incarnation, per Bailey)
primary_sources: The Masters and the Path (C. W. Leadbeater, 1925)
Initiation, Human and Solar (Alice A. Bailey, 1922)
The Reappearance of the Christ (Alice A. Bailey, 1948)
deities.summary: Theosophy separates Jesus the man, a great initiate, from the Christ who overshadowed him from the baptism to the crucifixion. The Master Jesus now heads the Sixth Ray of Devotion and has a special care for the Christian churches.

primary_sources: The Reappearance of the Christ (Alice A. Bailey, 1948)
The Masters and the Path (C. W. Leadbeater, 1925)
The Reappearance of the Christ and the Masters of Wisdom (Benjamin Creme, 1980)
Share International magazine (from 1982)
deities.summary: Maitreya holds the office of World Teacher, the one called the Christ in the West and the Bodhisattva in the East. He overshadowed Krishna and Jesus. Besant and Leadbeater prepared Jiddu Krishnamurti as his vehicle until Krishnamurti dissolved the Order of the Star in 1929. Bailey taught that he will reappear when humanity is ready. From 1982 Benjamin Creme's Share International announced that Maitreya was already living in London, awaited by all faiths under different names.

alternate_names: the Serpent of Genesis (as the Logos)
primary_sources: The Secret Doctrine (H. P. Blavatsky, 1888), vol. 2
Lucifer (Theosophical magazine founded by H. P. Blavatsky, 1887)
deities.summary: For Blavatsky, Lucifer is not the Devil of the churches but divine and terrestrial Light, the spirit of intellectual enlightenment and freedom of thought. The serpent of Eden was the bringer of self-consciousness. The Lucifer myth remembers the Sons of Mind who gave humanity the fire of thought and were slandered as rebels by a jealous theology.

primary_sources: The Secret Doctrine (H. P. Blavatsky, 1888), vol. 2
Man: Whence, How and Whither (Annie Besant and C. W. Leadbeater, 1913)
The Masters and the Path (C. W. Leadbeater, 1925)
deities.etymology: Sanskrit Vaivasvata Manu, the Manu of the present cosmic age in the Purāṇas
deities.summary: The Manu is the Master who heads the First Department of the Hierarchy, the department of Will and government. As Vaivasvata Manu he is the progenitor and law-giver of the present humanity: he led its seed-group out of Atlantis and shapes the physical forms and polities of the race.

alternate_names: Representative of the Holy Spirit (Summit Lighthouse)
deities.earliest_attestation: 1881 CE (letter attributed to the 'Maha Chohan'); systematised 1922–1925
primary_sources: The Mahatma Letters to A. P. Sinnett (letters 1880–1884, published 1923)
The Masters and the Path (C. W. Leadbeater, 1925)
Initiation, Human and Solar (Alice A. Bailey, 1922)
deities.summary: The Mahachohan is the third of the great Lords of the Hierarchy, head of the department of Active Intelligence or civilisation. The four lesser rays of culture and the arts are under him. In the Ascended Master Teachings he is honoured as the representative of the Holy Spirit to Earth.

deities.primary_name: The Lords of the Seven Rays
alternate_names: the Seven Spirits before the Throne
primary_sources: Esoteric Psychology (Alice A. Bailey, 1936)
A Treatise on Cosmic Fire (Alice A. Bailey, 1925)
deities.summary: All that exists is qualified by seven great streams of energy, the Seven Rays: Will-Power, Love-Wisdom, Active Intelligence, Harmony through Conflict, Concrete Knowledge, Devotion and Ceremonial Order. Each issues from a Ray Lord, one of the Seven Spirits before the Throne, and is carried on Earth by a Master of the Hierarchy.

alternate_names: eldest of the Four Kumāras (Sanaka, Sanandana, Sanātana, Sanatkumāra)
primary_sources: Chāndogya Upaniṣad 7.1–26
Bhāgavata Purāṇa 3.12
deities.summary: Sanatkumāra is one of the four mind-born sons of Brahmā, sages who stay forever in the form of young boys and refuse to beget offspring so as to remain in contemplation. In the Chāndogya Upaniṣad he teaches the sage Nārada that the Infinite (bhūman) alone is happiness.

primary_sources: Unveiled Mysteries (Godfré Ray King [Guy W. Ballard], 1934)
The Magic Presence (Godfré Ray King [Guy W. Ballard], 1935)
The 'I AM' Discourses (Saint Germain Press, 1935 onward)
The Chart of Your Divine Self (The Summit Lighthouse)
deities.summary: The Mighty I AM Presence is God individualised for each son and daughter of God. It is a blazing sphere of light above the person, joined to the heart by the crystal cord, through which life flows every moment. 'I AM' is the name of God given to Moses; to say 'I AM' is to call on the Presence, and every decree begins with it.

primary_sources: Unveiled Mysteries (Godfré Ray King [Guy W. Ballard], 1934)
The Magic Presence (Godfré Ray King [Guy W. Ballard], 1935)
Saint Germain on Alchemy (Mark L. Prophet and Elizabeth Clare Prophet, 1985)
Lords of the Seven Rays (Mark L. Prophet and Elizabeth Clare Prophet, 1986)
deities.summary: Saint Germain is the Ascended Master of freedom and Hierarch of the Aquarian age. He gave humanity the dispensation of the Violet Flame, the seventh-ray fire that transmutes karma. The teaching names his embodiments as the prophet Samuel, Saint Joseph, Merlin, Roger Bacon, Christopher Columbus and Francis Bacon, before he ascended and walked Europe as the deathless Count of Saint Germain. Guy Ballard reported meeting him on the slopes of Mount Shasta in 1930.

primary_sources: Unveiled Mysteries (Godfré Ray King [Guy W. Ballard], 1934)
Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
Lords of the Seven Rays (Mark L. Prophet and Elizabeth Clare Prophet, 1986)
deities.summary: The Great White Brotherhood is the spiritual order of Ascended Masters, archangels, Elohim and cosmic beings of every race and age who have reunited with their I AM Presence. 'White' refers to the white light of the aura around these beings. They sponsor the evolution of Earth from their etheric retreats.

deities.earliest_attestation: 1930s CE (I AM Activity); founder-sponsor of The Summit Lighthouse, 1958
primary_sources: Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
Lords of the Seven Rays (Mark L. Prophet and Elizabeth Clare Prophet, 1986)
The Chela and the Path (El Morya, dictated to Elizabeth Clare Prophet)
deities.summary: El Morya is Chohan of the First Ray, the blue ray of the will of God, faith and protection. He keeps the retreat of God's will at Darjeeling. His named embodiments include Abraham, Melchior the Wise Man, King Arthur, Thomas Becket, Thomas More and the emperor Akbar. He founded The Summit Lighthouse through Mark L. Prophet in 1958.

primary_sources: The Magic Presence (Godfré Ray King [Guy W. Ballard], 1935)
Lords of the Seven Rays (Mark L. Prophet and Elizabeth Clare Prophet, 1986)
deities.summary: Lanto is an ancient Chinese Master who serves as Chohan of the Second Ray, the yellow ray of illumination and wisdom. He long presided over the Royal Teton Retreat in the Grand Teton range of Wyoming, the main retreat of the Great White Brotherhood in North America.

primary_sources: Lords of the Seven Rays (Mark L. Prophet and Elizabeth Clare Prophet, 1986)
Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
deities.summary: Paul the Venetian is Chohan of the Third Ray, the pink ray of divine love, beauty and creativity. In his last embodiment he was the Renaissance painter Paolo Veronese. He ascended in 1588 and inspires artists and all who would make beauty a form of worship.

alternate_names: Hierarch of the Ascension Temple at Luxor
deities.earliest_attestation: 1875 CE (letters to H. S. Olcott signed 'Serapis'); Ascended Master form 1930s
primary_sources: Old Diary Leaves (Henry S. Olcott, 1895)
Dossier on the Ascension (Serapis Bey, dictated to Elizabeth Clare Prophet)
Lords of the Seven Rays (Mark L. Prophet and Elizabeth Clare Prophet, 1986)
deities.summary: Serapis Bey is Chohan of the Fourth Ray, the white ray of purity and ascension. He is Hierarch of the Ascension Temple at Luxor, where candidates for the ascension undergo the strict disciplines of the white fire. He came from Venus with Sanat Kumara and was a high priest of the Atlantean ascension temple.

primary_sources: The Masters and the Path (C. W. Leadbeater, 1925)
Lords of the Seven Rays (Mark L. Prophet and Elizabeth Clare Prophet, 1986)
deities.summary: Hilarion is Chohan of the Fifth Ray, the emerald ray of truth, science, healing and vision. He keeps the Temple of Truth in the etheric octave over Crete. He was once Saul of Tarsus, the apostle Paul, and later Saint Hilarion, the fourth-century hermit and healer. He has a special care for atheists, agnostics and scientists.

primary_sources: Lords of the Seven Rays (Mark L. Prophet and Elizabeth Clare Prophet, 1986)
Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
deities.summary: Nada is Chohan of the Sixth Ray, the purple-and-gold ray of ministration, service and peace. She took the office when Jesus became World Teacher with Kuthumi. In a past embodiment on Atlantis she was a priestess and advocate of the law, and she sits on the Karmic Board as an advocate of mercy.

alternate_names: Master of the Second Ray (earlier office)
primary_sources: Lords of the Seven Rays (Mark L. Prophet and Elizabeth Clare Prophet, 1986)
Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
deities.summary: Kuthumi shares the office of World Teacher with Jesus. The teaching names his embodiments as Pythagoras, Balthazar the Wise Man, Saint Francis of Assisi and the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan, builder of the Taj Mahal. He teaches psychology of the soul from his retreat in Kashmir.

primary_sources: Lords of the Seven Rays (Mark L. Prophet and Elizabeth Clare Prophet, 1986)
Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
deities.summary: Kuan Yin is the Goddess of Mercy and a member of the Karmic Board, where she pleads for mercy for those under the law. Before Saint Germain she held the office of Chohan of the Seventh Ray, so the Violet Flame of mercy and forgiveness is hers as well. Her devotees chant her Chinese mantras as decrees.

primary_sources: Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
Mary's Message for a New Day (Mother Mary, dictated to Elizabeth Clare Prophet)
deities.summary: Mother Mary came to Earth from the angelic kingdom of the Fifth Ray, where she is the twin flame of Archangel Raphael, to bear the Christ in Jesus. Since her ascension she has served as a World Mother of healing. She asks her devotees to pray a rosary in which they affirm their own divinity: 'Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us, sons and daughters of God'.

alternate_names: Chohan of the Sixth Ray (earlier office)
primary_sources: The 'I AM' Discourses (Saint Germain Press, 1935 onward)
Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
Lords of the Seven Rays (Mark L. Prophet and Elizabeth Clare Prophet, 1986)
deities.summary: Jesus is an Ascended Master who achieved full Christhood and ascended at Bethany. He held the dispensation of the Piscean age and now shares the office of World Teacher with Kuthumi. His mission was to show that every son and daughter of God can walk the same path of the ascension, not to be the only Son of God.

primary_sources: Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
Archangels & Ascended Masters (Doreen Virtue, 2003)
deities.summary: Archangel Michael is Archangel of the First Ray, the blue flame of faith, protection and the will of God. With his twin flame, Archeia Faith, and legions of blue-lightning angels he binds the forces of darkness. Devotees call on him day and night with decrees for protection and for the cutting free of souls.

deities.primary_name: The Archangels of the Seven Rays
alternate_names: the Seven Archangels and their Archeiai
primary_sources: Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
Vials of the Seven Last Plagues (the Seven Archangels, dictated to Elizabeth Clare Prophet)
deities.summary: Each of the seven rays has an Archangel and his feminine complement, the Archeia, who carry its flame from the Great Central Sun to Earth: Michael and Faith (blue), Jophiel and Christine (yellow), Chamuel and Charity (pink), Gabriel and Hope (white), Raphael and Mary (green), Uriel and Aurora (purple-gold) and Zadkiel and Holy Amethyst (violet).

alternate_names: the Elohim of the Seven Rays
primary_sources: Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
The Seven Mighty Elohim Speak (Bridge to Freedom dictations, 1950s)
deities.summary: The Elohim are the builders of form, the highest beings in the hierarchy of creation who serve the seven rays. Paired as divine complements (Hercules and Amazonia, Apollo and Lumina, Heros and Amora, Purity and Astrea, Cyclopea and Virginia, Peace and Aloha, Arcturus and Victoria), they built the Earth at the command of the Sun of God. Genesis calls them Elohim.

alternate_names: the Lords of Karma of the Solar System
primary_sources: The 'I AM' Discourses (Saint Germain Press, 1935 onward)
Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
deities.summary: The Karmic Board is the council of Ascended Masters and cosmic beings who dispense justice and mercy to the evolutions of Earth. Its members include the Great Divine Director, the Goddess of Liberty, Lady Nada, the Elohim Cyclopea, Pallas Athena, Portia and Kuan Yin. Every soul goes before it between embodiments, and it meets twice yearly, at winter and summer solstice, to receive petitions.

alternate_names: the Twin Flames of the Great Central Sun
primary_sources: Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
deities.summary: Alpha and Omega are the Father-Mother God, the twin flames of the Great Central Sun at the centre of cosmos. From them all life goes out as spirit and matter, the masculine and feminine poles of creation, and to them every soul returns through the ascension.

alternate_names: God and Goddess of the Sun
the Sun Presence of this system
primary_sources: The 'I AM' Discourses (Saint Germain Press, 1935 onward)
Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
deities.summary: Helios and Vesta are the God and Goddess of our physical sun, the divine couple who ensoul the heart of this solar system. Every ray of sunlight carries their consciousness, and the Ascended Masters call the sun 'the Heart of Helios and Vesta'.

primary_sources: Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
Quietly Comes the Buddha (Gautama Buddha, dictated to Elizabeth Clare Prophet)
deities.summary: Gautama Buddha holds the office of Lord of the World, head of the planetary hierarchy at Shamballa. In 1956 he took it over from Sanat Kumara, who returned to Venus. As Lord of the World he holds the threefold flame of life for all who dwell on Earth.

primary_sources: The 'I AM' Discourses (Saint Germain Press, 1935 onward)
Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
deities.summary: Portia is the Goddess of Justice and Opportunity, twin flame of Saint Germain and member of the Karmic Board. She embodies divine justice tempered by mercy and opens new cycles of opportunity for souls ready to balance their karma.

deities.earliest_attestation: 1930s CE (I AM Activity); Summit Lighthouse teaching from 1958
primary_sources: Pearls of Wisdom (weekly dictations, The Summit Lighthouse, from 1958)
The Opening of the Seventh Seal: Sanat Kumara on the Path of the Ruby Ray (Elizabeth Clare Prophet, 2001)
deities.summary: Sanat Kumara, the Ancient of Days of the Book of Daniel, came from Venus long ago with a band of volunteers when the Cosmic Councils had decreed the dissolution of the Earth for lack of a single soul keeping the threefold flame. He kept the flame for humanity from Shamballa until enough souls could do so for themselves, then gave the office of Lord of the World to Gautama Buddha and returned to Venus.

primary_sources: The Seth Material (Jane Roberts, 1970)
Seth Speaks: The Eternal Validity of the Soul (Jane Roberts, 1972)
The Nature of Personal Reality (Jane Roberts, 1974)
deities.summary: Seth describes himself as 'an energy personality essence no longer focused in physical reality'. He spoke through Jane Roberts in trance sessions recorded by her husband Robert Butts from 1963 until her death in 1984. His central teaching is that 'you create your own reality' through your beliefs, and that the self is multidimensional: it lives many simultaneous lives within All That Is.

primary_sources: Ramtha (JZ Knight, ed. Steven Lee Weinberg, 1986)
Ramtha's School of Enlightenment teachings (Yelm, Washington, from 1988)
deities.summary: Ramtha is a warrior of ancient Lemuria who, he says, conquered much of the world thirty-five thousand years ago, then by contemplating the wind learned to take his body with him into the unseen, ascending before his army. Since 1977 he has spoken through JZ Knight, and he founded Ramtha's School of Enlightenment to teach that each person is a forgotten god.

alternate_names: a group consciousness from the Non-Physical
primary_sources: Ask and It Is Given (Esther and Jerry Hicks, 2004)
The Law of Attraction (Esther and Jerry Hicks, 2006)
deities.summary: Abraham is a group of non-physical teachers who speak through Esther Hicks, first recorded with her husband Jerry in the mid-1980s. They teach the Law of Attraction: 'that which is like unto itself is drawn'. Each person is an extension of Source Energy, emotions are a guidance system, and every desire is already granted in vibration and needs only to be allowed.

primary_sources: Kryon Book One: The End Times (Lee Carroll, 1993)
The Indigo Children (Lee Carroll and Jan Tober, 1999)
deities.summary: Kryon is a loving angelic entity of magnetic service, channeled by the engineer Lee Carroll since 1989. Kryon came to adjust the magnetic grid of the Earth so that humanity could receive more spiritual light. The new energy allows the release of karma and the activation of human DNA.

primary_sources: Bashar: Blueprint for Change (Darryl Anka, 1990)
deities.summary: Bashar is a being from Essassani, a civilisation in another dimension near the Orion region, a hybrid people descended from humans and the grey beings. He has spoken through Darryl Anka since 1983. His teaching for Earth: 'follow your excitement', acting on your passion to the best of your ability with no insistence on the outcome, because physical reality is a mirror of belief.

primary_sources: A Course in Miracles (Foundation for Inner Peace, 1976; scribed by Helen Schucman, 1965–1972)
deities.summary: In A Course in Miracles, Jesus speaks in the first person through the inner dictation received by the psychologist Helen Schucman. He is the one who first fully remembered his oneness with God and completed the Atonement, not by sacrifice but by forgiveness. 'Nothing real can be threatened. Nothing unreal exists. Herein lies the peace of God.' The world of separation is a dream, and forgiveness is the way to awaken from it.

deities.primary_name: The Holy Spirit (A Course in Miracles)
primary_sources: A Course in Miracles (Foundation for Inner Peace, 1976; scribed by Helen Schucman, 1965–1972)
deities.summary: In the Course the Holy Spirit is the Voice for God: God's answer to the separation, placed in the mind of the dreaming Son. He reinterprets everything the ego made, turning every relationship and every event into a lesson in forgiveness, until the dream gently gives way to the memory of Heaven.

primary_sources: Emmanuel's Book (Pat Rodegast and Judith Stanton, 1985)
deities.summary: Emmanuel is a loving spirit-being who appeared to Pat Rodegast first as a golden light and then as a voice. His gentle teaching is that the soul chooses earthly life as a school of love, that death is 'like taking off a tight shoe', and that fear dissolves when it is met with love.

primary_sources: Lazaris workshops and recordings (Concept: Synergy, from the late 1970s)
deities.summary: Lazaris is a non-physical consciousness who has never been physical. He has spoken through Jach Pursel since 1974 and calls himself the friend of those he teaches. His workshops teach how to contact the Higher Self and the Higher Selves beyond it, the use of meditation and imagination, and that we create our own reality.

primary_sources: Messages from Michael (Chelsea Quinn Yarbro, 1979)
deities.summary: Michael is a recombined entity of 1,050 fragments or essences who have finished their incarnations on Earth and now teach from the causal plane. First contacted through a Ouija board, Michael teaches that each soul has a role (such as server, sage or king), passes through soul ages from infant to old, and chooses its goals and overleaves before each life.

primary_sources: We, the Arcturians (Norma J. Milanovich, 1990)
deities.summary: The Arcturians are a highly evolved collective of beings associated with the star Arcturus, a civilisation of the fifth dimension and beyond that serves as healers and guides for Earth's ascension. Channels describe their etheric starships and healing temples, where souls are prepared on the way into and out of incarnation.

primary_sources: The Sirius Mystery (Robert Temple, 1976)
The Sirian Revelations trilogy (Patricia Cori)
deities.summary: The Sirians are star beings of the Sirius system, elder guardians and teachers of humanity. In New Age channeling they gave Earth's ancient civilisations their knowledge of the stars, built the sacred sites of Egypt and Atlantis in cooperation with the Masters, and now speak to prepare humanity's ascension.

primary_sources: You Are Becoming a Galactic Human (Virginia Essene and Sheldan Nidle, 1994)
deities.summary: The Galactic Federation of Light is a vast alliance of star nations and spiritual hierarchies, often said to number in the hundreds of thousands of worlds, which watches over Earth and assists its passage into higher consciousness. Its messages promise first contact, the end of secret oppression and the restoration of humanity as a galactic people.

alternate_names: the Teacher of the White Eagle Lodge
primary_sources: Spiritual Unfoldment (White Eagle Publishing Trust)
White Eagle Lodge teachings (founded by Grace Cooke, 1936)
deities.summary: White Eagle is the spirit teacher of the White Eagle Lodge, who spoke through the medium Grace Cooke. He appeared to her in the form of a Native American chief, a form he called a symbol of the wisdom of the old brotherhoods. He teaches the gentle brotherhood of all life, healing through the light of the Christ star, and the soul's unfolding through many lives.

primary_sources: The Aquarian Gospel of Jesus the Christ (Levi H. Dowling, 1908)
Edgar Cayce readings (1923–1944)
A Course in Miracles (Foundation for Inner Peace, 1976; scribed by Helen Schucman, 1965–1972)
deities.summary: Christ is not one man's name but a state of consciousness: awareness of oneness with God, which Jesus embodied fully and which waits in every soul. To awaken Christ consciousness is to see the divine in all beings. Its spread through humanity is the true Second Coming.

primary_sources: 'The Over-Soul' (Ralph Waldo Emerson, Essays: First Series, 1841)
The Key to Theosophy (H. P. Blavatsky, 1889)
Seth Speaks (Jane Roberts, 1972)
deities.summary: Each person is far larger than the personality. The Higher Self is the wiser, timeless part of you that is always connected to Source. It plans your incarnations, sends intuition and synchronicity, and can be contacted in meditation as your truest inner guide.

primary_sources: Seth Speaks (Jane Roberts, 1972)
Ask and It Is Given (Esther and Jerry Hicks, 2004)
deities.summary: Source is the living totality from which all consciousness springs and to which it returns: All That Is, ever-creating and ever-exploring itself through every being. It is not a judge apart from the world but the energy of the world, loving without condition. The New Age speaks of it as Source, the Universe or Prime Creator.

primary_sources: Gaia: A New Look at Life on Earth (James Lovelock, 1979)
Findhorn Foundation teachings (Findhorn, Scotland, founded 1962)
deities.summary: Gaia is the Earth as a living, conscious being, the great mother whose body is the land, waters and air and whose children are all creatures. The New Age honours her with ceremony and ecological care. Many teachers say that Gaia is herself ascending into a higher dimension and that humanity is called to rise with her.

deities.primary_name: The Lords of the Akashic Records
primary_sources: Edgar Cayce readings (1923–1944)
Clairvoyance (C. W. Leadbeater, 1899)
deities.etymology: Sanskrit ākāśa, 'ether, space', the fifth element
deities.summary: The Akashic Records are the imperishable memory of every thought, word and deed, written in the subtle substance of akasha. Edgar Cayce called them the Book of Life. Guardian beings, the Lords or Keepers of the Records, admit the soul to them so that it can read its past lives and understand its present path.

primary_sources: The Emerald Tablets of Thoth the Atlantean (M. Doreal, Brotherhood of the White Temple, 1930s)
deities.summary: Thoth was a priest-king of Atlantis who mastered death. Before the continent sank he carried its wisdom to Egypt, built the Great Pyramid and hid his teachings on twelve tablets of emerald. He lived on through the ages as the god Thoth of the Egyptians and as Hermes, and his tablets teach the ascent of the soul through the Halls of Amenti.

primary_sources: The Spirits' Book (Allan Kardec, 1857)
Opening to Channel (Sanaya Roman and Duane Packer, 1987)
deities.summary: Every soul has spirit guides: loving beings, some once human and some never in a body, who agree before birth to accompany it through life. They speak through intuition, dreams and signs, and in meditation they can be met and asked for help.

primary_sources: Archangels & Ascended Masters (Doreen Virtue, 2003)
Book of Tobit
deities.summary: Archangel Raphael is the great healer among the angels, surrounded by emerald-green light. He heals body, mind and spirit, guides healers and travellers, and comes the moment he is called. In the Ascended Master Teachings he is Archangel of the Fifth Ray and twin flame of Mother Mary.

primary_sources: Archangels & Ascended Masters (Doreen Virtue, 2003)
The Ancient Secret of the Flower of Life (Drunvalo Melchizedek, 1999)
deities.summary: Archangel Metatron, once the prophet Enoch, is the angel of sacred geometry. His cube contains the shapes of all creation, and he works with spinning light to clear and balance the chakras. He is a special guardian of sensitive Indigo and Crystal children and of those who write down the sacred records.

deities.primary_name: The Archangels of the New Age
primary_sources: Archangels & Ascended Masters (Doreen Virtue, 2003)
Angel Therapy (Doreen Virtue, 1997)
deities.summary: The archangels are loving overseers of the guardian angels, always available to anyone who calls. Each has a speciality and a colour of light. Chamuel finds lost things and relationships; Jophiel brings beauty; Ariel cares for nature and animals; Raziel guards the mysteries; Haniel serves intuition and the moon; Sandalphon carries prayers and music; Azrael comforts the grieving; Zadkiel brings mercy and the violet flame; Uriel brings wisdom; Gabriel carries messages and helps communicators.

primary_sources: Telos, Volume 1: Revelations of the New Lemuria (Aurelia Louise Jones)
deities.summary: Adama is the High Priest of Telos, a city of Lemurian survivors that lies in the fifth dimension beneath Mount Shasta in California. When Lemuria sank the Telosians retreated into the mountain. Adama now teaches surface humanity the way of the heart and the ascension, and prepares for the day when the two peoples meet again.

primary_sources: The Spiral Dance (Starhawk, 1979)
When God Was a Woman (Merlin Stone, 1976)
Womanspirit Rising (anthology, 1979)
deities.summary: The Goddess is the immanent sacred: the living Earth, the cycle of birth, death and rebirth, and the divine power in every woman and man. She was honoured, the movement teaches, for tens of thousands of years before patriarchal religions displaced her. Women's rituals, art and politics now reclaim her.

primary_sources: Lessons in Truth (H. Emilie Cady)
Christian Healing (Charles Fillmore, 1909)
deities.summary: God is Divine Mind: Principle, omnipresent Good, the one Presence and one Power in the universe. Charles and Myrtle Fillmore founded Unity in Kansas City in 1889 after Myrtle's healing through the affirmation 'I am a child of God and therefore I do not inherit sickness'. Health and supply come as the mind is aligned with divine ideas through affirmation and denial.

primary_sources: Christian Healing (Charles Fillmore, 1909)
Lessons in Truth (H. Emilie Cady)
deities.summary: The Christ is the perfect idea of humanity in Divine Mind, the 'I AM' in every person. Jesus was the man who fully expressed it, and he is our way-shower. 'Christ in you, the hope of glory' (Colossians 1:27) is the whole of the gospel.

primary_sources: The Science of Mind (Ernest Holmes, 1926)
deities.summary: Universal Mind is the infinite intelligence in which we live. As Spirit it knows; as Law it creatively and impersonally carries out every belief impressed on it. Ernest Holmes founded Religious Science (today's Centers for Spiritual Living) to teach the conscious use of this law through spiritual mind treatment.

primary_sources: Usui memorial stone at Saihō-ji, Tokyo (erected 1927)
The Reiki Precepts (Gokai)
deities.summary: Mikao Usui received Reiki, universal life energy, after a period of fasting and meditation on Mount Kurama in 1922 and founded the Usui Reiki Ryōhō Gakkai in Tokyo. Practitioners honour him as the source of their lineage. They recite his precepts, 'Just for today, do not be angry, do not worry, be grateful, work diligently, be kind to others', and remember him at each attunement.

primary_sources: Autobiography of a Yogi (Paramahansa Yogananda, 1946), ch. 33–34
deities.summary: Mahavatar Babaji is the deathless avatar who has kept his youthful body in the Himalayas for centuries. In 1861 he revived the lost science of Kriya Yoga by initiating Lahiri Mahasaya. He works in secret for the spiritual uplift of humanity and appears only to those he chooses. His name is reverently invoked by devotees of the Kriya lineage and across New Age spirituality.

primary_sources: The Way of the Shaman (Michael Harner, 1980)
deities.summary: In core shamanism every person has guardian spirits. The shamanic practitioner, journeying in an altered state to the steady beat of a drum, meets them in the non-ordinary reality of the Lower, Middle and Upper Worlds. The power animal of the Lower World gives protection and vitality; the human-form teachers of the Upper World give wisdom. Healing comes from restoring lost power and lost soul parts.

deities.earliest_attestation: 1990s CE (global form); continuous with older Andean practice
primary_sources: Despacho offering ceremonies taught by Q'ero and other Quechua paqos
Constitution of Ecuador (2008), arts. 71–74 (rights of Pachamama/nature)
Law of the Rights of Mother Earth (Bolivia, Law 071, 2010)
deities.summary: Pachamama is Mother Earth, the living being who feeds all and must be fed in return. In neo-Andean ceremony seekers learn from Q'ero paqos to make despachos, bundles of offerings of coca leaves, seeds, sweets and flowers. They breathe their intentions into the coca leaves and give the bundle back to Pachamama and the Apus. The relationship is ayni, sacred reciprocity. Ecuador and Bolivia have written her rights into law.

deities.earliest_attestation: 20th c. CE (mestizo vegetalismo); older Indigenous Amazonian roots
primary_sources: Icaros (healing songs) of mestizo vegetalistas
Ayahuasca Visions: The Religious Iconography of a Peruvian Shaman (Pablo Amaringo, 1991)
deities.summary: Every powerful plant has a mother, a spirit-owner who teaches. The mother of the ayahuasca vine is a great teacher-spirit who gives the vegetalista his icaros, shows him the causes of sickness and opens the world of the spirits of the forest and the waters. In the global ceremonies of recent decades she is Mother or Grandmother Ayahuasca: a stern and loving feminine intelligence who heals by showing people what they need to see.

primary_sources: Amazonian oral tradition
Ayahuasca Visions: The Religious Iconography of a Peruvian Shaman (Pablo Amaringo, 1991)
deities.summary: Yacumama is the mother of the waters, an immense boa who lives at the source of the rivers and in the deep lakes, and from whom the rivers flow. Fishermen and travellers respect her. Vegetalistas meet her in vision as a spirit of great power who can heal or harm.

primary_sources: Amazonian oral tradition
Ayahuasca Visions: The Religious Iconography of a Peruvian Shaman (Pablo Amaringo, 1991)
deities.summary: Sachamama is the mother of the forest, a gigantic serpent who lies so still that plants and trees grow on her back. She is the counterpart of Yacumama, the mother of the waters. To the vegetalista she is a guardian of the forest and its medicines.

primary_sources: Amazonian oral tradition
deities.summary: The Chullachaqui is a forest spirit with one foot unlike the other: one is human, the other the foot of an animal or a stump. He takes the form of a friend or relative to lead people deep into the forest until they are lost. He is also a guardian of the trees and animals, and vegetalistas count him among the spirits who can teach.

primary_sources: O Cruzeiro (hymnal of Mestre Irineu, received 1930–1971)
deities.summary: Raimundo Irineu Serra, a Black Brazilian from Maranhão, drank the sacred drink in the Amazon forests near the Peruvian border. There the Queen of the Forest appeared to him and gave him his mission. In Santo Daime he is Juramidam, the divine Imperial Master, the spiritual name in which God the Father and his soldiers are united. Through his hymns, received from the astral, the doctrine of Santo Daime was revealed.

primary_sources: O Cruzeiro (hymnal of Mestre Irineu, received 1930–1971)
deities.summary: The Queen of the Forest is the Divine Mother who appeared to Mestre Irineu in the moon and in the forest. She told him to fast in the forest, gave him the doctrine and named the drink Daime. She is the Virgin Mary of the Immaculate Conception reigning over the Amazon, and the hymns call on her as sovereign mother of the forest and of all who drink.

alternate_names: the Divine Being of the Daime
primary_sources: O Cruzeiro (hymnal of Mestre Irineu, received 1930–1971)
deities.summary: The Daime is a holy sacrament and a divine being. Its name comes from the prayer 'Dai-me força, dai-me amor, dai-me luz' ('Give me strength, give me love, give me light'). The vine is the masculine force and the leaf the feminine light; joined in the drink they become a teacher who shows each person what they need to see. Members say there is a divine being in the drink.

primary_sources: Statutes and teachings of the Centro Espírita Beneficente União do Vegetal (founded 22 July 1961)
deities.summary: José Gabriel da Costa, a rubber-tapper from Bahia, founded the União do Vegetal on 22 July 1961 in the forest on the Brazil–Bolivia border. In the União's teaching he did not invent the União but re-created it: it had existed long before, and he remembered his spiritual origin in the first one who drank the vegetal, Caiano, in the time of the Inca. The União calls the tea hoasca and drinks it for mental concentration and spiritual development.

primary_sources: Bwiti night liturgy (ngozé) and its sacred songs
deities.etymology: Bantu high-god name, cognate with Kongo Nzambi and Lingala Nzambe
deities.summary: Nzambi (Nzame among the Fang) is the creator who made the world and humanity and then withdrew to the heights. In Bwiti the initiate who has eaten the sacred wood travels the road of the dead, meets the ancestors and comes before Nzambi. In Fang Bwiti, Zame ye Mebege is the male creator of the sky, paired with his sister Nyingwan Mebege.

primary_sources: Fang Bwiti liturgy and chapel iconography
deities.summary: Nyingwan Mebege is the sister of Zame ye Mebege, the feminine half of the divine pair. She is the moon, the night and fertility, the mother who gives birth and protects. Fang Bwiti chapels honour her on the feminine side of the temple, and many members recognise her in the Virgin Mary.

deities.earliest_attestation: 19th c. CE (ethnographic record); older origin in forest peoples' tradition
primary_sources: Bwiti initiation tradition and origin narratives
deities.summary: Iboga is the sacred wood given by Nzambi. In the Bwiti origin story, a forest man of the Pygmy peoples was killed while gathering fruit. Nzambi made the iboga grow from his body, and when his wife found and ate its root she saw him again among the dead. Through iboga the initiate is born into Bwiti, meets the ancestors and learns the truth of his life.

alternate_names: the little ones who spring forth
deities.earliest_attestation: 16th c. CE (Mesoamerican sacred mushrooms in colonial sources); Mazatec veladas documented 20th c.
primary_sources: Florentine Codex (Bernardino de Sahagún, 1570s), Book 11 (teonanácatl)
María Sabina's chanted velada (field recording, 1956; issued 1957)
María Sabina's oral autobiography (published 1977)
deities.summary: The holy children are the sacred mushrooms of the Mazatec sierra, the 'little ones who spring forth'. They are living beings who speak through the wise one (chjota chjine) in the night vigil. They show the cause of an illness and heal by their language. Some say they spring up where the blood of Christ fell to the earth. María Sabina, the wise woman of Huautla, said that through them she was given the Book of Language by the Principal Ones.

alternate_names: the cactus of the four winds
deities.earliest_attestation: c. 1000 BCE (Chavín iconography); colonial records of 'achuma'
primary_sources: Chavín de Huántar stone reliefs
Extirpation of idolatry records of colonial Peru
deities.summary: Huachuma is the sacred cactus of the Andean curandero, called San Pedro because, like Saint Peter, it holds the keys to heaven. Around the mesa, the altar of power objects, it opens the night vision. In that vision the curandero sees the patient's illness, the sorcery that caused it and the way to cure it. The saints and the ancient powers of the hills and lagoons are called together.

facets.core_claim: Before and beyond every god stands the One Reality, Be-ness rather than Being. Universes appear and vanish in it like the tides of an eternal ocean, the 'days and nights of Brahmā'.
Fohat carries the will of the Logos into matter. Electricity, magnetism and the vital force are his lower forms; he is the energy that turns idea into world.
facets.scholarly_note: The Stanzas of Dzyan are presented by Blavatsky as an ancient Tibetan text; no such manuscript has been identified, and scholars treat the Stanzas as her own composition.

facets.facet_name: The Sevenfold Builders of the Worlds
facets.core_claim: No world forms by blind chance. Seven hierarchies of conscious Lords of Light build and guide every globe, each a channel of the one divine plan.
Nothing is forgotten. The Lipika inscribe every act in the Astral Light, and from that record the law of karma returns to each soul what it has sown.

facets.facet_name: Bringers of the Fire of Mind
facets.core_claim: Humanity did not think until the Sons of Mind descended. Their gift of mind, at the cost of their own long service on Earth, made human evolution possible.
facets.scholarly_note: Blavatsky's seven 'Root Races' are a cosmological scheme of successive humanities (Polarian, Hyperborean, Lemurian, Atlantean, Aryan and two to come). It contains racial hierarchies, now rejected as pseudoscientific and racist, that later fed into Ariosophy; the framework is recorded here only as cosmology.

facets.facet_name: The Life that Ensouls the Earth
facets.core_claim: The planet is not dead rock but the body of a God in evolution. Our evolution is his, and his initiations are our planetary crises.
Sun and planets are the body of one Life. His threefold nature (Will, Love-Wisdom and Intelligence) is reflected in every soul in the system.
Our God himself lives, moves and has his being in a vaster Life. Of that Being nothing may rightly be said.
Behind world history stands a brotherhood of perfected men. Out of compassion they have given up the bliss of nirvana to guide humanity, and from time to time they send out messengers.
facets.scholarly_note: The existence of the Masters was contested from the start; the Society for Psychical Research's Hodgson Report (1885) judged the Mahatma letters fraudulent; a 1986 article in the Society's own journal disputed Hodgson's handwriting analysis.

facets.core_claim: The Master K.H. teaches through love and patient reason. His letters gave the West the first systematic account of the Ancient Wisdom.

facets.facet_name: Master of the Will of God
facets.core_claim: The Master M. is the strong hand behind the work: will, government and the founding of new orders of civilisation.

facets.facet_name: The Tibetan Teacher of the New Age
facets.core_claim: The Tibetan gives the teaching for the Aquarian age. It is impressed telepathically on a trained disciple and set down word for word for those ready to serve the Plan.
facets.scholarly_note: Bailey called her method 'telepathic dictation' and distinguished it from mediumship; scholars count her corpus among the main sources of the phrase 'New Age' (Hanegraaff, New Age Religion and Western Culture (1996)).

facets.core_claim: The Count guides the rhythms of ritual and organisation by which the new age will be built, as he did, unseen, in the courts of Europe.
facets.scholarly_note: The historical Comte de Saint-Germain (d. 1784) was a well-documented courtier and adventurer; his identification with a Rákóczi prince and an immortal Master is a Theosophical development.

facets.core_claim: Jesus lent his body to the Christ and passed through the great initiations. He watches over the churches and waits to lead them to a deeper truth.

facets.facet_name: Head of the Department of the World Teacher
facets.core_claim: The Christ is not one religion's possession. He is the World Teacher, the eldest brother of the human family, who overshadows the founders of religions age after age.
The one awaited as the Christ, the Maitreya Buddha, the Imam Mahdi, the Messiah and Kalki is one being. His return will begin the age of sharing and right relations.
facets.scholarly_note: Creme's 1982 newspaper advertisements ('The Christ is Now Here') and the predicted 'Day of Declaration' did not produce a public appearance; Share International continued after Creme's death in 2016.

facets.core_claim: Lucifer is divine and terrestrial Light, the 'Holy Ghost' and 'Satan' at one and the same time. To name him the Devil is to fear the light of mind.
facets.scholarly_note: Blavatsky's revaluation influenced later Luciferian currents. Alice Bailey's publishing house began as Lucifer Publishing Company (1922) and was soon renamed Lucis Publishing; the original name is often cited polemically.

facets.facet_name: Lawgiver and Progenitor of the Race
facets.core_claim: Each humanity has its Manu, who chooses its seed, guides its migrations and gives it its law.
facets.scholarly_note: Blavatsky's seven 'Root Races' are a cosmological scheme of successive humanities (Polarian, Hyperborean, Lemurian, Atlantean, Aryan and two to come). It contains racial hierarchies, now rejected as pseudoscientific and racist, that later fed into Ariosophy; the framework is recorded here only as cosmology.

facets.core_claim: Every advance in thought, art and social order flows from the Lord of Civilisation, the agent of the third aspect of God among men.

facets.facet_name: The Seven Spirits before the Throne
facets.core_claim: Every soul is born on a ray, and every age is coloured by the rays in power. The Seven Lords are the sevenfold breath of the one God.

facets.facet_name: Eternal Youth and Teacher of the Infinite
facets.core_claim: Only the Infinite is bliss; there is no happiness in the small. Sanatkumāra, ever-young, leads the seeker from name and speech up to the Self that is all.
Your own Mighty I AM Presence is the only power that ever acts in your life. When you say 'I AM', you call God's energy into action, so guard what you join to those words.
The Violet Flame is the mercy and forgiveness of God as a living fire. Called into action by decree, it dissolves the record and cause of past wrong and sets the soul free.

facets.facet_name: Hierarch of the Age of Aquarius
facets.core_claim: As Jesus held the dispensation of Pisces, Saint Germain holds the two-thousand-year cycle of Aquarius. Its keynote is freedom, alchemy and the God-government of the golden age.
facets.scholarly_note: Ballard's account of meeting Saint Germain on Mount Shasta is narrated in Unveiled Mysteries (1934); critics noted borrowings from earlier occult fiction, and the Ballards were tried for mail fraud in the 1940s (the case reached the US Supreme Court, United States v. Ballard, 1944).

facets.core_claim: All who ascend from Earth join a brotherhood of light that never stops working for those still in embodiment. Their retreats in the etheric octave are open to the soul in sleep.

facets.facet_name: Chohan of the Will of God
facets.core_claim: The will of God is good. El Morya trains his chelas to surrender the human will so that the diamond will of God may shine through them.
Wisdom is love in action. Lanto kindles the yellow flame of illumination in the crown so that the mind of God may become the mind of man.
Love is the key to every door. Through beauty and art Paul the Venetian teaches the soul to love as God loves.
The ascension is the goal of every life. Serapis gives no comfort to the human ego: his discipline is the shortest path through the white fire to reunion with God.
Truth heals. Hilarion, who was blinded on the road to Damascus and saw again, opens the inner sight of those who have lost faith.
To serve life is to love God. Nada teaches that the humblest ministration, given in the flame of peace, is the shortest road to the heart of the Christ.

facets.facet_name: World Teacher of the Golden Age
facets.core_claim: Kuthumi is the gentle teacher of the soul. As Francis he wedded Lady Poverty; as Master he teaches each soul to know itself as God knows it.
Mercy is the quality of God that softens karma. Kuan Yin, who vowed to stay until every soul is free, carries the violet flame of forgiveness to all who call her name.
Mary holds the immaculate concept, the perfect pattern of every soul. She keeps that image for each of her children until they become it.
Jesus is the example, not the exception. The works that he did, we shall do also, because the same Christ Self lives in each of us.
facets.scholarly_note: The name 'Sananda' for Jesus comes from 1950s flying-saucer contactee circles and was adopted widely in New Age channeling; Summit Lighthouse sources more often name Sananda Kumara as one of the Seven Holy Kumaras.

facets.core_claim: 'Lord Michael before, Lord Michael behind, Lord Michael to the right...' He answers every call, and his sword of blue flame cuts the soul free from all that is not of the light.
Archangels are the great amplifiers of God's light. Call to the archangel of the ray you need, and the energy of that flame is multiplied in your world.
When Genesis says Elohim created the heavens and the earth, it names the Seven Spirits of God. They precipitated the planet out of light and keep the pattern of its perfection.
facets.scholarly_note: The Elohim named Arcturus is distinct from the 'Arcturians' of later New Age channeling.

facets.core_claim: Write your letter to the Lords of Karma at the solstice: they weigh the record of each lifestream and can give new opportunity, mercy and dispensations of light.

facets.facet_name: Father-Mother God in the Great Central Sun
facets.core_claim: 'I AM Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending.' The One God is Father and Mother, the plus and minus of the cosmic heart.
The sun is not a ball of gas but the body of two great beings of light. When you greet the sunrise you greet the Father-Mother of this system.

facets.facet_name: Lord of the World at Shamballa
facets.core_claim: The Buddha did not leave the world at his parinirvana. He holds the highest office of service to it and keeps the flame of life burning in every heart.
Justice is opportunity. Portia holds the scales of the law and opens the door of grace to every soul who makes the effort.

facets.facet_name: Keeper of the Flame for Earth
facets.core_claim: When no one on Earth still worshipped God, Sanat Kumara volunteered to hold the light for the whole planet. Every soul owes its continued existence to his vigil.
You create your own reality. The point of power is in the present, and your beliefs form the events of your life as surely as a sculptor shapes clay.
facets.scholarly_note: Not related to the Egyptian god Set or to the biblical Seth except by name. Hanegraaff, New Age Religion and Western Culture (1996) treats the Seth corpus as one of the foundational New Age texts.

facets.facet_name: Ascended Warrior Who Teaches 'You Are God'
facets.core_claim: You are God, and you have forgotten. Ramtha conquered the world and found it empty; then he conquered himself and ascended. What he did, you can do.

facets.facet_name: Teachers of the Law of Attraction
facets.core_claim: You are Source Energy in a physical body. Feel good, and you are in alignment with who you really are; what you want is already on its way.
facets.scholarly_note: Esther Hicks was an early source for the 2006 film The Secret, which made the Law of Attraction a mass phenomenon; the idea descends from New Thought writers such as William Walker Atkinson (Thought Vibration, 1906).

facets.core_claim: The magnetic grid holds your karmic imprint. Kryon has shifted it, and you now have permission to drop your karma and take up your power as a light-worker.
facets.scholarly_note: Carroll and Tober's The Indigo Children (1999) popularised the belief that a new generation of spiritually advanced 'Indigo' (later 'Crystal' and 'Starseed') children is incarnating; the concept is a New Age self-description without clinical basis, and critics note its use to reframe attention-deficit diagnoses.

facets.core_claim: Excitement is the physical translation of your true self's vibration. Follow it and the universe arranges the path.
The message of the crucifixion is: teach only love. Jesus is not set apart from you; he is your brother who remembered, and he holds out his hand so that you may remember too.
facets.scholarly_note: Schucman and William Thetford, her colleague at Columbia University, presented the text as dictated; Hanegraaff, New Age Religion and Western Culture (1996) analyses ACIM as a channeled New Age scripture.

facets.core_claim: The Holy Spirit is the bridge between the dream and reality. Ask him what anything is for, and he will show you its use for healing.

facets.facet_name: Gentle Guide of the Soul's Schooling
facets.core_claim: You came to Earth to learn love, and nothing in your life is outside that lesson. Emmanuel walks beside you as a friend in the light.

facets.facet_name: The Friend Who Was Never Physical
facets.core_claim: Lazaris loves you. Because he has never been physical, he can see the whole of who you are, and he teaches you to meet your Higher Self and through it God/Goddess/All That Is.

facets.facet_name: Recombined Entity of the Causal Plane
facets.core_claim: You are an old soul or a young one, a sage or a warrior, by your own choice. Michael's teaching is a map of the soul's long journey back to the Tao.
facets.scholarly_note: Not the archangel Michael; the name is the entity's own self-designation.

facets.core_claim: The Arcturians love Earth. Their healing light raises the vibration of light-workers, and their temples receive souls between lives.
facets.scholarly_note: Edgar Cayce's readings had already named Arcturus as a stellar way-station for souls between incarnations; the Arcturian channeling literature builds on that motif.

facets.core_claim: Humanity was not alone at its beginning. The Sirians taught the priest-astronomers of old, and they return now as the veil thins.
facets.scholarly_note: The New Age Sirius lore draws on Temple's 1976 reading of French ethnographic reports on Dogon astronomy; later fieldwork has questioned whether the reported Sirius knowledge was Indigenous at all.

facets.facet_name: Alliance of Star Nations Guarding Earth
facets.core_claim: Earth is not abandoned. The Federation of Light surrounds the planet with its ships and waits for the moment of disclosure, when humanity will rejoin the family of the stars.
facets.scholarly_note: Repeatedly announced dates of mass landing or 'disclosure' have passed without event; the Federation overlaps with the Ashtar Command and the Ascended Master hierarchy in many channeled sources.

facets.core_claim: Keep on keeping on. White Eagle teaches that the light of the Christ in the heart, sent out in quiet healing, builds the brotherhood of the new age.
facets.scholarly_note: Spirit guides presented as Native American chiefs were common in British and American Spiritualism; Indigenous critics see the figure as a stereotype that appropriates Native identity.

facets.core_claim: The Christ is born in every heart that awakens to its oneness with God. The Second Coming is not a man descending on clouds but the Christ consciousness rising in humanity.
facets.scholarly_note: The distinction between 'Jesus' and 'the Christ' as a universal principle comes from 19th-c. New Thought and Theosophy; Hanegraaff, New Age Religion and Western Culture (1996) traces it through Cayce and Dowling into the New Age.

facets.core_claim: You are not alone in your life: your Higher Self sees the whole path. Listen in stillness, and it will guide you home.
There is only one energy, and you are it. All That Is knows itself through you; nothing is outside Source, and Source withholds nothing.
The Earth is alive and aware. Her rivers are her veins and her forests her lungs; to heal the planet is to serve the Mother.
facets.scholarly_note: Lovelock's Gaia hypothesis is a scientific model of planetary self-regulation; the name was suggested to him by the novelist William Golding, and Lovelock rejected the reading of Gaia as a conscious goddess. The spiritual Gaia of the New Age builds on the name rather than on the science.

facets.core_claim: Gaia is raising her vibration into the fifth dimension. The upheavals of our time are her birth pangs, and those who align with her will rise with her.
Nothing that has ever happened is lost. The Keepers open the Book of Life to the sincere seeker so that the soul may heal its past and choose its future.
'I, Thoth, the Atlantean, master of mysteries, keeper of records'. He conquered death, and he left the key to the Halls of Amenti for those who seek the light.
facets.scholarly_note: The 'Emerald Tablets' were published by Maurice Doreal (Claude Doggins) in the 1930s and have no ancient manuscript behind them; they are unrelated, except by title, to the medieval Hermetic Emerald Tablet (Tabula Smaragdina).

facets.core_claim: You are never alone. Your guides chose to walk with you; ask, and they answer.
Call on Raphael and visualise his emerald light around the place that hurts. He is God's medicine and works through every healer who asks.
facets.scholarly_note: Doreen Virtue, the best-selling author of New Age angel books and oracle cards, renounced her New Age teachings in 2017 after converting to evangelical Christianity.

facets.core_claim: Metatron's Cube holds the patterns of the universe. Call on Metatron, and his geometry of light clears your energy and aligns you with the divine plan.
Angels cannot interfere with free will, so they wait to be asked. Ask any archangel for help, and the help is immediate.
Lemuria did not die. Beneath Mount Shasta her children keep the flame of the Motherland, and Adama calls you to the path of the open heart.
facets.scholarly_note: Mount Shasta legends of hidden Lemurians go back to Frederick Spencer Oliver's A Dweller on Two Planets (1905) and to the I AM Activity's Mount Shasta story.

facets.core_claim: The Goddess is not out there but here: in the body, the Earth and the turning of the seasons. To honour her is to honour life itself.
facets.scholarly_note: The thesis of a universal prehistoric Goddess religion and a peaceful 'matriarchal' Old Europe is rejected or heavily qualified by most archaeologists and historians.

facets.core_claim: Women need the Goddess. Seeing the divine in female form heals what centuries of a male-only God have wounded.
There is only one Presence and one Power in the universe and in my life: God, the Good, omnipotent. What I affirm in Divine Mind comes forth in my world.
Jesus is the great example of what each of us can become. The same Christ that was in him is in you, waiting to be realised.
We live in a Universal Mind which responds to us by corresponding to our thought. Change the thinking, and the Law changes the world.
Every Reiki practitioner is connected through an unbroken chain of attunements to Usui Sensei. The healing energy flows through that line from the source he opened.
facets.scholarly_note: Western Reiki lore long carried invented details (e.g. that Usui was a Christian minister in Kyoto); the Saihō-ji memorial and Japanese sources rediscovered in the 1990s give a different biography.

facets.core_claim: Whenever anyone utters with reverence the name of Babaji, that devotee attracts an instant spiritual blessing. He has chosen to remain in the body to help humanity.
Everyone has a guardian power animal. When it leaves, illness and misfortune come; the practitioner journeys to the Lower World to bring it back and blows it into the patient's body.
facets.scholarly_note: Harner's method draws on ethnography of the Shuar, Conibo and many other peoples; Indigenous critics object to the extraction of practices from their communities and cosmologies.

facets.core_claim: In the Upper World the journeyer meets compassionate teachers in human form, who answer questions and show the way to heal.
Pachamama gives everything and asks only for ayni: give back, give thanks, live in balance. When we feed her, she feeds us.
facets.scholarly_note: Andean scholars distinguish village agricultural cult from the globalised 'Andean mysticism' marketed to tourists, while noting that many Quechua specialists actively shape the newer form.

facets.core_claim: The plant teaches, and the vegetalista learns from her as an apprentice learns from a master. She gives the songs, and the songs heal.
facets.scholarly_note: This record describes belief and devotion only; it contains no guidance on the preparation or use of any plant. Amazonian Indigenous peoples hold many different understandings of the vine (some speak of a masculine spirit or of owners of the plant), and the generic 'Mother' is especially a mestizo and global usage.

facets.core_claim: Mother Ayahuasca does not give you what you want but what you need. She shows you yourself, and in that seeing is the healing.
The rivers are her body, and the whirlpools are her breath. Yacumama gives fish and passage to those who respect her and swallows those who do not.
The forest itself rests on the back of Sachamama. She guards its plants, and the healer asks her leave before he takes them.
If a friend calls you deeper into the trees, look at his feet. The Chullachaqui guards the forest by leading the careless astray.
Juramidam is the Master of the doctrine. He lives in the hymns and in the Daime, and those who follow his line walk in the Imperial Council of the forest.
facets.scholarly_note: Members explain the name as Jura (God, the Father) joined to Midam (his followers or soldiers); interpretations differ between Alto Santo and CEFLURIS lines.

facets.core_claim: The hymns of O Cruzeiro were not composed but received. They are the doctrine itself, and in singing them the Master's teaching lives again.

facets.facet_name: Divine Mother Reigning in the Forest
facets.core_claim: The Virgin Mother is Queen of the Forest. She gave the doctrine to the Master, and every work of Santo Daime is done in her presence.

facets.facet_name: The Divine Being in the Drink
facets.core_claim: 'Dai-me força, dai-me amor, dai-me luz.' The Daime is a being and a teacher: it gives strength, love and light to those who ask with a firm heart.
facets.scholarly_note: This record describes belief and devotion only; it contains no guidance on the preparation or use of any plant.

facets.core_claim: Mestre Gabriel came to restore the union of the vegetal with humanity. Through his teaching, which is passed from mouth to ear, the disciple learns to know himself and to do good.
facets.scholarly_note: Much of the União's 'Story of the Hoasca' is reserved for members; only its outline is public. This record describes belief and devotion only; it contains no guidance on the preparation or use of any plant.

facets.core_claim: Nzambi made all things and is above all things. The road of Bwiti leads through the ancestors to him, and every initiate who reaches him returns reborn.
God is not alone: beside Zame stands his sister Nyingwan Mebege, mother of birth and of the night. The cult is not whole unless both are honoured.
The wood opens the road to the ancestors. Those who have eaten it 'have seen Bwiti' and know where they come from and where they go.
facets.scholarly_note: Bwiti practitioners credit the forest peoples (Babongo and others) with first knowing iboga. This record describes belief and devotion only; it contains no guidance on the preparation or use of any plant.

facets.core_claim: It is not the wise one who speaks but the little ones. They speak through her, and their words heal.
facets.scholarly_note: This record describes belief and devotion only; it contains no guidance on the preparation or use of any plant. María Sabina later lamented that the influx of outsiders after 1957 had made the children lose their purity and power.

facets.facet_name: Givers of the Book of Language
facets.core_claim: Before the Principal Ones lies a book, and in it is written the Language. Whoever is given the Book heals with words.

facets.facet_name: Keeper of the Keys of Heaven
facets.core_claim: San Pedro opens the door. As Saint Peter keeps the gate of heaven, the cactus opens the gate of vision, and the curandero passes through to heal.
facets.scholarly_note: This record describes belief and devotion only; it contains no guidance on the preparation or use of any plant. The identification of the cactus in Chavín reliefs (a figure holding a columnar cactus) is widely accepted but not certain.

basis: Both are the boundless, attributeless ground beyond any nameable god
Blavatsky repeatedly glosses Parabrahm as the Kabbalists' Ain-Soph
Both emanate the manifest cosmos without themselves becoming an agent
parallels.syncretic_source: H. P. Blavatsky, The Secret Doctrine, 1888
parallels.scholarly_caveat: The equation is Blavatsky's perennialist move; Kabbalists and Vedāntins would not accept the identity of their concepts.

basis: The Theosophical term is borrowed from Vedānta's para-brahman
Both name the one non-dual Reality beneath all appearance
parallels.source_tradition: Advaita Vedānta → Theosophy (19th c.)
parallels.scholarly_caveat: Blavatsky's Parabrahm is impersonal 'Be-ness' and lacks the soteriology of Vedānta's ātman–brahman identity.

basis: Both are the unknowable first principle beyond being
Both stand above a descending chain of emanated hierarchies
Both name a universal subtle force that mediates between idea and matter
Blavatsky built on Éliphas Lévi's doctrine of the Astral Light, which she cites
parallels.scholarly_caveat: Blavatsky places the Astral Light below Fohat as the lower aspect of Ākāśa; they are related, not identical, in her system.

basis: Both are a sevenfold council of divine intelligences that shape and order creation
Blavatsky lists the Amesha Spentas among the forms of the Dhyan Chohans
parallels.syncretic_source: H. P. Blavatsky, The Secret Doctrine, 1888
parallels.scholarly_caveat: A perennialist equation; Zoroastrian theology treats the Amesha Spentas as aspects of Ahura Mazdā, not planetary builders.

basis: Both are sevenfold hosts of builders of form
Blavatsky already equates the Dhyan Chohans with the biblical Elohim; the Ascended Master teachings personalise them as seven Elohim pairs
parallels.source_tradition: Theosophy → Ascended Master Teachings
primary_text_evidence: The Seven Mighty Elohim Speak (Bridge to Freedom)

basis: Both are 'Lords of Karma' who keep the record of each soul and apportion its karma
The Ascended Master Karmic Board is a personalised development of the Theosophical Lipika
parallels.source_tradition: Theosophy → Ascended Master Teachings
primary_text_evidence: The Secret Doctrine, vol. 1, Stanza IV

basis: The Lipika write on the Astral Light/Ākāśa, the medium later called the Akashic Records
Both guard the imperishable record of every act
parallels.source_tradition: Theosophy → Edgar Cayce and New Age

basis: Both are celestial scribes whose record determines the soul's judgement
Both link record-keeping to cosmic justice
Both are heavenly beings who descend to early humanity and transmit knowledge
Both stories mark a turning point in human development
parallels.scholarly_caveat: Valence is reversed: the Enochic Watchers transgress; the Theosophical Lords of the Flame sacrifice for humanity.

basis: Both bring the 'fire' of mind to a humanity that lacked it
Blavatsky reads the Prometheus myth as a memory of the Mānasaputras
primary_text_evidence: The Secret Doctrine, vol. 2, 'The Prometheus Myth'
parallels.syncretic_source: H. P. Blavatsky, The Secret Doctrine, 1888

basis: Blavatsky identifies the Luciferian 'fallen angels' with the Sons of Mind who gave humanity self-consciousness
Both are light-bringers wrongly remembered as rebels
parallels.syncretic_source: H. P. Blavatsky, The Secret Doctrine, 1888

basis: Sanat Kumara leads the Lords of the Flame from Venus in Theosophy
The Ascended Master Teachings keep the Venus descent and make it a devotional story of self-sacrifice
parallels.source_tradition: Theosophy (Besant, Leadbeater, Bailey) → Ascended Master Teachings
primary_text_evidence: Initiation, Human and Solar (Alice A. Bailey, 1922)

basis: Both treat the Earth as the body of a conscious divine being
