Both see human evolution as part of the planet's own spiritual development
parallels.scholarly_caveat: Bailey's Planetary Logos is masculine and hierarchical; the New Age Gaia is a mother goddess.

basis: Both are the divine Life whose body is the sun of our system
The Ascended Master Helios and Vesta personalise the Theosophical Solar Logos
parallels.source_tradition: Theosophy → Ascended Master Teachings
primary_text_evidence: A Treatise on Cosmic Fire (Alice A. Bailey, 1925)

basis: The Ascended Master naming of the sun's deity revives the Greek Helios
Both are the personal god of the physical sun
parallels.scholarly_caveat: This link runs through the Ascended Master use of the name; Bailey herself does not call the Solar Logos Helios.

basis: Both are a higher, unnameable Life beyond the god who forms our world
Both are approached through apophatic language
Same order of perfected Masters guiding humanity, under the same names (Morya, Koot Hoomi, Serapis, Rakoczi/Saint Germain)
The Ascended Master movements explicitly continue the Theosophical Great White Lodge
parallels.source_tradition: Theosophy → Ascended Master Teachings
primary_text_evidence: The Mahatma Letters to A. P. Sinnett

basis: Same Master under the same name; the Ascended Master teaching continues his Theosophical biography (Pythagoras)
Both hold the second-ray, teaching office
parallels.source_tradition: Theosophy → Ascended Master Teachings
primary_text_evidence: The Mahatma Letters to A. P. Sinnett

basis: Bailey places Koot Hoomi on the second ray; the Ascended Master teaching gives that ray's chohanship to Lanto
Both are Masters of wisdom and illumination
The Ascended Master teaching names Francis of Assisi as an embodiment of Kuthumi
Both are presented as gentle teachers of love toward all creatures
parallels.syncretic_source: I AM Activity (Guy and Edna Ballard), 1930s; The Summit Lighthouse (Mark L. and Elizabeth Clare Prophet), from 1958
parallels.scholarly_caveat: Catholic tradition does not accept reincarnation or the identification.

basis: Same Master under the same name; both are Master of the First Ray of Will
The Summit Lighthouse was founded in his name
parallels.source_tradition: Theosophy → Ascended Master Teachings
primary_text_evidence: The Mahatma Letters to A. P. Sinnett

basis: Both corpora are received by a woman scribe through inner dictation from a named Master
Both present themselves as teaching for the new age
parallels.scholarly_caveat: Bailey and Schucman each rejected the label 'medium'; the comparison concerns the mode of reception, not the content.

basis: The Theosophical Master Rakoczi is the Count of Saint Germain; the Ascended Master Saint Germain keeps this identification
Both hold the Seventh Ray of ceremonial order and transmutation
parallels.source_tradition: Theosophy → Ascended Master Teachings

basis: Same figure: Jesus as a perfected Master of the Sixth Ray of Devotion
The Ascended Master teaching inherits the Theosophical separation of Jesus from the cosmic Christ office
parallels.source_tradition: Theosophy → Ascended Master Teachings

basis: The Theosophical World Teacher takes the name and future-coming role of the Buddhist Maitreya
Both are compassionate teachers who will appear to renew the dharma
parallels.source_tradition: Buddhism → Theosophy (late 19th c.)
primary_text_evidence: Anāgatavaṃsa (Pali, on the future Buddha Metteyya)
parallels.scholarly_caveat: In Buddhism, Maitreya will come only in the far future, after the decline of the present dharma; the Theosophical Maitreya is active now and is equated with Christ.

basis: Bailey and Creme identify Maitreya with the Christ whose return Christians await
Both are the expected return of the world saviour at the turn of an age
parallels.syncretic_source: Alice A. Bailey, The Reappearance of the Christ, 1948; Benjamin Creme, Share International, from 1982
parallels.scholarly_caveat: Rejected by all mainstream Christian churches.
parallels.source_tradition: Alice A. Bailey, The Reappearance of the Christ, 1948; Benjamin Creme, Share International, from 1982

basis: Creme presents Maitreya as the one Hindus await as Kalki
Both are returning saviours at the end of an age
parallels.syncretic_source: Benjamin Creme, The Reappearance of the Christ and the Masters of Wisdom, 1980
parallels.scholarly_caveat: Hindu tradition places Kalki at the end of the Kali Yuga and does not identify him with Maitreya.

basis: Creme presents Maitreya as the one Muslims await as the Imam Mahdi
Both are an expected guide who restores justice at the end of an age
parallels.syncretic_source: Benjamin Creme, The Reappearance of the Christ and the Masters of Wisdom, 1980
parallels.scholarly_caveat: Rejected by Sunni and Shia authorities.

basis: Theosophy calls the World Teacher 'the Christ' who overshadowed Jesus from baptism to crucifixion
Both are a divine teacher who descends into a human life
parallels.syncretic_source: Annie Besant and C. W. Leadbeater, 1900s–1920s; Alice A. Bailey, 1948
parallels.scholarly_caveat: Orthodox Christology rejects the separation of Jesus from the Christ.

basis: Blavatsky takes the Christian Lucifer of Isaiah 14:12 and reverses his valence
Same name and light-bearer role; fall reread as gift
parallels.source_tradition: Christian tradition → Theosophy
parallels.scholarly_caveat: A deliberate polemical revaluation of Christian demonology.

basis: Both venerate Lucifer as bringer of light and liberating knowledge
Both reject the Christian identification of Lucifer with evil
parallels.scholarly_caveat: Blavatsky's Lucifer is a cosmic principle of mind; modern Luciferian groups vary and are not simply derived from Theosophy.

basis: Theosophy borrows the Purāṇic Vaivasvata Manu, progenitor and lawgiver of the present age
Both lead a seed of humanity through a flood or catastrophe (Atlantis in Theosophy, the deluge in Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa)
parallels.source_tradition: Hindu tradition → Theosophy

basis: The Ascended Master teaching calls the Maha Chohan the representative of the Holy Spirit to Earth
Both are the agent of the third aspect of the Trinity at work in the world
parallels.syncretic_source: The Summit Lighthouse (Mark L. and Elizabeth Clare Prophet), from 1958
parallels.scholarly_caveat: Christian theology does not admit a created representative of the Holy Spirit.

basis: Both are sevenfold divine powers, each the source of one of the Seven Rays
Ascended Master ray theology builds on Bailey's Seven Rays
Theosophy and the Ascended Master teachings take the name of the ever-young sage Sanatkumāra
Both are ageless 'eternal youths' who teach the way to the Infinite
parallels.source_tradition: Hindu tradition → Theosophy → Ascended Master Teachings
primary_text_evidence: Initiation, Human and Solar (Alice A. Bailey, 1922)
parallels.scholarly_caveat: The Venus origin and planetary kingship have no Hindu basis; only the name and the 'eternal youth' character are taken over.

basis: Both locate the supreme divine as the true Self of each person
Both teach that the soul's goal is conscious union with that inner divinity
The I AM teaching takes the divine name of Exodus 3:14 ('I AM THAT I AM') as the name of the Presence in each person
Both make the revealed Name the point of contact between God and people
parallels.syncretic_source: I AM Activity (Guy and Edna Ballard), 1930s
parallels.scholarly_caveat: In the Hebrew Bible the Name belongs to the transcendent God of Israel; the individualising reading is the I AM Activity's.

basis: Both are the divine self above the personality that guides the soul
New Age Higher Self teaching took in the Summit Lighthouse 'Chart of Your Divine Self'
Both are named holders of the Seventh Ray violet flame of mercy and transmutation
Both are invoked to dissolve karma by forgiveness
The Ascended Master teaching assigns each a two-thousand-year age (Pisces to Jesus, Aquarius to Saint Germain)
Both are hierarchs who open an age's dispensation of grace
The Master's name and Egyptian setting (Luxor) come from the Ptolemaic god Serapis
Letters signed 'Serapis' from an Egyptian 'Brotherhood of Luxor' reached H. S. Olcott in 1875
parallels.scholarly_caveat: The Ascended Master is a perfected human adept, not the Greco-Egyptian god of the Serapeum; only the name and Egyptian association pass over.

basis: Both centre on a human being taken bodily into heaven without ordinary death
The ascension is presented as a model that worthy souls can follow
Both serve the fifth-ray (emerald) office of healing in Ascended Master ray theology
Both are invoked for healing and restored sight (Tobit; Paul at Damascus)
Same bodhisattva of compassion, honoured with her Chinese name and mantras
Both vow to remain until all beings are freed
parallels.syncretic_source: I AM Activity (Guy and Edna Ballard), 1930s; The Summit Lighthouse (Mark L. and Elizabeth Clare Prophet), from 1958
parallels.scholarly_caveat: Chinese Buddhist and folk traditions do not place Guanyin in a Western hierarchy of Ascended Masters or on a Karmic Board.
parallels.source_tradition: I AM Activity (Guy and Edna Ballard), 1930s; The Summit Lighthouse (Mark L. and Elizabeth Clare Prophet), from 1958

basis: Guanyin derives from Avalokiteśvara; the Ascended Master figure inherits both
Both are the compassionate hearer of the world's cries
parallels.source_tradition: Indian Buddhism → Chinese Buddhism → Ascended Master Teachings

basis: Same Mother of Jesus, invoked with the rosary as intercessor
Both bestow graces and healing on those who call on her
parallels.syncretic_source: I AM Activity (Guy and Edna Ballard), 1930s; The Summit Lighthouse (Mark L. and Elizabeth Clare Prophet), from 1958
parallels.scholarly_caveat: The Catholic Church rejects the reworded 'New Age' rosary and the teaching that Mary came from the angelic kingdom.
parallels.source_tradition: I AM Activity (Guy and Edna Ballard), 1930s; The Summit Lighthouse (Mark L. and Elizabeth Clare Prophet), from 1958

basis: Same Jesus of Nazareth, reinterpreted as an Ascended Master who achieved Christhood
Both are the teacher who reveals the way to God
parallels.syncretic_source: I AM Activity (Guy and Edna Ballard), 1930s; The Summit Lighthouse (Mark L. and Elizabeth Clare Prophet), from 1958
parallels.scholarly_caveat: Christian orthodoxy holds Jesus to be uniquely God incarnate, not one Master among many.
parallels.source_tradition: I AM Activity (Guy and Edna Ballard), 1930s; The Summit Lighthouse (Mark L. and Elizabeth Clare Prophet), from 1958

basis: Same archangel, defender against the forces of darkness, invoked for protection
Sword and warfare against the dragon become the 'sword of blue flame'
parallels.syncretic_source: I AM Activity (Guy and Edna Ballard), 1930s; The Summit Lighthouse (Mark L. and Elizabeth Clare Prophet), from 1958; Doreen Virtue, 2003

basis: Both assign archangels to colours of light and specific helping functions
New Age angel literature drew on the Ascended Master ray-archangels (Jophiel, Chamuel, Zadkiel)
Both are a heptad (or hexad around God) of high creative powers through whom the One creates and orders the world
Both judge the soul between lives and weigh its record against divine law
Both combine justice with cosmic order
Both conceive the supreme God as Father-Mother
Both are the single source of all being
Both are a central source from which all life radiates as light and to which it returns
Same Gautama Buddha, reinterpreted as head of the planetary hierarchy
Both are the compassionate teacher of liberation
parallels.syncretic_source: The Summit Lighthouse (Mark L. and Elizabeth Clare Prophet), from 1958
parallels.scholarly_caveat: Buddhist doctrine holds that the Buddha attained parinirvāṇa and holds no office in the world.
parallels.source_tradition: The Summit Lighthouse (Mark L. and Elizabeth Clare Prophet), from 1958
